fuchsmod.config.general.tooltip_scroll.e:
Allows to move tooltips vertically with the mouse wheel.
Hold shift to scroll horizontally.

fuchsmod.config.general.tooltip_scroll.v: Determine in which direction the tooltip will be scrolled vertically.
fuchsmod.config.general.tooltip_scroll.h: Determine in which direction the tooltip will be scrolled horizontally.
fuchsmod.config.general.fullbright.enabl: If enabled, the custom brightness will be set as brightness. Otherwise, the vanilla brightness setting is used.
fuchsmod.config.general.brightness.descr: Set a custom brightness. 100% is the normal Brightness.
fuchsmod.config.general.zoom.enable.desc: If enabled, allows to zoom by holding control and scrolling with the mouse wheel.
fuchsmod.config.general.smooth_camera.de: If enabled, the camera is set to move smoothly while zooming.
fuchsmod.config.general.zoom_factor.desc: Determine by how much a scroll should zoom.
fuchsmod.config.general.immediate_zoom_f: Determine by how much the zoom hotkey scales.
fuchsmod.config.general.server_resource_: If enabled, the Server Resource Pack will be ignored automatically.
The server is notified that you 'successfully loaded' the resource pack after this time in milliseconds.
If enabled, the link to the download source of the resource pack will be sent in chat. Be careful with suspicious links.
fuchsmod.config.general.calculator.preci: Determine to how many significant decimal places results should be rounded. Actual precision may be limited by limitations of the double datatype (~15 digits).
fuchsmod.config.general.calculator.defau:
Determine which layout the calculator screen should use by default when opening it.
Simple: Numbers and Operators 
Advanced: Also shows Functions
fuchsmod.config.general.calculator.inven: Enables an Calculator Field accessible in the Inventory.
fuchsmod.config.general.death_message_sa: Send a message in your chat on death to copy your death location and show your death location on hover.

fuchsmod.config.partycommands.command_de: A command execution is delayed by this time in milliseconds.
fuchsmod.config.partycommands.configure_:
Configure Party Commands here.
A command will be executed if the trigger is found in a chat message with matching scope.
Placeholders allow to modify the command depending on variables:
- {player} The senders player name
- {chat} The slash command for the chat of the scope
  - For example, if the scope is 'party', this placeholder becomes '/pc'
- {args[i]} Arguments after trigger, starting at index 0
  - For example, {args[0]} refers to the first argument
- {function} Return value of a selectable replacement function
fuchsmod.config.partycommands.editor.tri: The command will be executed if this string is found in chat.
fuchsmod.config.partycommands.editor.exe: This is the command to be executed. The {player} placeholder will be replaced with the senders name. Use the {args[i]} placeholders to add arguments given after the trigger.
fuchsmod.config.partycommands.editor.rep: On execution, the placeholder {function} will be replaced by this functions return value.
